sizing.why_1_5x_not_2x: The campaign already consumes $276.25/day at its 2x ceiling, so $207.24 is BELOW proven consumption and is certain to be used. It lifts the daily ceiling from $276.32 to $414.48 without doubling the planned budget, which keeps the learning phase stable and keeps total August exposure provably inside the maximum.
sizing.why_not_the_full_gap: Closing 63.82% budget-lost implies roughly $763/day of available demand. Jumping there is a 5.5x step on a campaign with 3 weeks of history and zero recorded conversions, and it would break the exposure guarantee below.

august_exposure_proof.guarantee: Even if EVERY campaign hit Google's maximum 2x overdelivery on EVERY remaining day, August would total $12875.79, which is still under the $13,000 maximum. This increase is safe by construction and needs no spend guardrail to stay compliant.
august_exposure_proof.realistic_projection: Yesterday the five spent $914.72 in total. At a similar run rate for 11 more days August lands near $12,000. At the more typical $400-600/day seen earlier it lands near $6,400-$8,500. Both are under the maximum.
august_exposure_proof.note: $13,000 is a maximum, not a quota. No attempt is made to reach it.
